name: Public Health Birth Data: Birth Outcomes
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Department.Publishing Department: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: Source data does not differentiate between gender and sex assigned at birth. For clarity and brevity, metadata descriptions reflect gendered language with the understanding that these descriptions may not accurately reflect all cases.
Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Place
columns.description: CCDPH jurisdiction refers to all Cook County municipalities except Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park, Forest View, Burbank, and (incorporated) Stickney. See the attached district map for more information.

columns.name: Race and Ethnicity
columns.description: Race and ethnicity of mother. "NH" refers to "non-Hispanic". "PI" refers to "Pacific Islander".

columns.name: Count of Early Preterm Births
columns.description: Total number of births delivered before 34 completed weeks of gestation

columns.name: Rate of Early Preterm Births
columns.description: Number of births delivered before 34 completed weeks of gestation per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Late Preterm Births
columns.description: Total number of births delivered between 34 to 36 completed weeks of gestation

columns.name: Rate of Late Preterm Births
columns.description: Number of births delivered between 34 to 36 completed weeks of gestation per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Low Birth Weight
columns.description: Total number of single births with birth weight less than 2,500 grams

columns.name: Rate of Low Birth Weight
columns.description: Number of single births with birth weight less than 2,500 grams per 100 single live births

columns.name: Count of Neutral Tube Defects
columns.description: Total number of births with anencephaly or spina bifida/meningocele

columns.name: Rate of Neutral Tube Defects
columns.description: Number of births with anencephaly or spina bifida/meningocele per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Preterm Births
columns.description: Total number of births delivered before 37 completed weeks of gestation

columns.name: Rate of Preterm Births
columns.description: Number of births delivered before 37 completed weeks of gestation per 100 live births

columns.name: Count of Very Low Birth Weight
columns.description: Total number of single births with birth weight less than 1,500 grams

columns.name: Rate of Very Low Birth Weight
columns.description: Number of single births with birth weight less than 1,500 grams per 100 live single live births

columns.name: Count of Inadequate APGAR Score
columns.description: Total number of births with 5-minute APGAR (Appearance, Pulse, Grimace response, Activity, Respiration) score less than 7. This data is only available for the "All Ages" age group.

columns.name: Rate of Inadequate APGAR Score
columns.description: Number of births with 5-minute APGAR (Appearance, Pulse, Grimace response, Activity, Respiration) score less than 7 per 100 live births. This data is only available for the "All Ages" age group.
